The Safety Integrity Program Manager, Harmful Activity will drive priorities, measures, and system health for harmful activity, owning program standards and execution across upstream systems and downstream operations.

You are skilled at setting requirements for detection and automation, translating policy and legal constraints into practical workflows and controls, and driving cross-functional partners to improve coverage, precision, and enforcement quality. You thrive in fast-paced environments and excel at turning operational signals into lasting improvements.

Drive priorities, measures, and system health for harmful activity, and continuously improve execution
Set requirements and success criteria for detection and automation, and drive Product, Engineering, and Operations to improve coverage, precision, and enforcement quality at scale.
Translate legal, policy, and technical constraints into practical requirements, workflows, controls, and escalation paths for Product, Engineering, and Operations.
Identify gaps in the current framework and drive enhancements to policies, procedures, controls, and workflows.
Own escalations, quality assurance, and complex case patterns for residual volume, and use those signals to harden standards and automation over time.
Align and drive Product, Engineering, Policy, Legal, and Operations partners to resolve dependencies, make decisions, and move critical work forward with clear accountable ownership.
Build and maintain the documentation, guidance, and operating standards that embed consistent execution across the program.
Monitor relevant regulatory developments, assess impact on the program, and ensure requirements stay accurate and executable.
Track and report operational performance, risks, and improvement opportunities with clear recommendations for leadership.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
5+ years in content integrity, safety operations, abuse operations, or related program roles supporting enforcement or risk programs at scale.
Experience owning or supporting program priorities, measures, and operational health for content or risk domains.
Working knowledge of harmful activity domains and how policy, legal, and technical constraints shape response.
Experience translating policy or legal requirements into practical workflows, controls, and escalation paths.
Experience working with automated or model-driven enforcement systems, including detection, classifiers, or policy automation.
Proven ability to drive cross-functional work with Product, Engineering, Policy, Legal, and Operations partners.
Strong analytical skills with experience using operational data to identify gaps, prioritize interventions, and track outcomes.
Clear written and verbal communication; able to brief leadership and document standards, decisions, and recommendations.
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Direct experience with harmful activity, integrity, or abuse programs at scale.
Experience setting requirements for detection, classifiers, or automation and partnering with Product or Engineering teams on outcomes.
Experience owning escalations, quality assurance, or residual case handling for enforcement programs.
Experience converting operational signals into product, process, or policy changes.
Exposure to integrity risks involving synthetic content, model misuse, or scaled manipulation.
Experience improving operating standards, documentation, and controls in a live program environment.
Background in high-scale consumer platforms, marketplaces, or technology products.

Understanding of Agile or Scrum methodologies. Familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools. Good analytical, communication, and organizational skills. Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken); fluent Spanish. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, Git, cloud (AWS or Azure), or containerization (Docker). Experience validating regulatory or financial reporting pipelines and data reconciliation. Portuguese language skills. Experience working in a global matrixed organization with offshore/nearshore delivery models. Track grievance trends and proactively recommend solutions to mitigate recurring issues. Resolve labor disputes through collaboration and constructive engagement, both within and outside the formal grievance process. Requests for Information (RFIs) Manage and respond to union Requests for Information in compliance with legal obligations and contractual timelines in conjunction with Director of Labor (Legal). Coordinate with HR, ER, Legal, and operational leaders to gather and review responsive information. Ensure responses are accurate, timely, and strategically aligned with company legal guidance. Labor Relations Strategy & Partnership Serve as a key advisor to HR and business leaders on implementing labor relations strategy and risk management. Partner closely with the Director, Labor Law and Legal team on complex labor matters, and dispute resolution. Maintain productive working relationships with union leadership and bargaining committees. Provide strategic support during collective bargaining negotiations, including proposal review, costing analysis, scenario planning, and leadership briefings. Management Training & Capability Building Design and deliver labor relations training programs for managers and HR partners, including: Microsoft Labor Principles adherence Contract interpretation Grievance handling Compliance with the National Labor Relations Act (NLRA) Provide ongoing labor relations coaching and support to managers. MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS Required Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Labor Relations, Industrial Relations, Business, Law, or a related field AND 7+ years’ experience in HR, mediation or alternative dispute resolution, collective bargaining or ER-related roles OR Master's Degree in Industrial-Organizational Psychology, Human Resources (HR), Business Administration, Organizational Leadership, Industrial Relations, Law, or related field AND 6+ years' experience in HR, mediation, collective bargaining or Employee Relations (ER)-related roles OR equivalent, substantial experience Expertise and ability to apply all aspects of the National Labor Relations Act (NLRA) as well as employment and human resources related laws, regulations, policies, and practices. Demonstrated track record of building and sustaining productive, trust‑based relationships with union representatives and other labor stakeholders. Demonstrated experience in collective bargaining agreement administration and implementation. Demonstrated management-side experience in grievances, arbitrations, and/or negotiations. Proven ability to advise leaders and influence outcomes in complex situations. Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and lead labor relations initiatives and special projects in a complex, matrixed environment. Preferred Experience supporting unionized environments within gaming, entertainment, technology, or creative industries. Experience supporting inaugural CBA implementation. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization. We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. WHAT MAKES US EPIC?
At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.
Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
PRODUCT MANAGEMENT - UNREAL ENGINE
What We Do
Unreal-powered projects have led the way in real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of industry experts continuously innovates to enhance the tools and technology that empower developers around the world.
What You'll Do
The Unreal Ecosystem empowers developers to create and publish the next generation of digital entertainment to hundreds of millions of global consumers. As a Senior Director of Product Management, Unreal Ecosystem, you will serve as the senior business partner to our engine development leadership, owning strategy and growth for Unreal Editor for Fortnite, UE6 and other Epic developer tools and services. You will define \vision and strategy, partner with product development to bring that vision to life, and work closely with our GTM teams to drive adoption and commercial outcomes.You will bring both strategic vision and operational rigor to one of the most consequential platforms in real-time 3D creation and digital entertainment.
In this role, you will
Drive ecosystem strategy for Unreal Editor for Fortnite and Unreal Engine, partnering closely with engineering and product leadership to prioritize initiatives that drive creator growth, developer adoption, platform performance, and commercial outcomes
Define measurable goals for major roadmap initiatives, track business impact across releases, and use those insights to continuously refine prioritization
Stay deeply connected to the UEFN creator and UE developer community, translating their needs and behaviors into ecosystem strategy alongside the creator success team
Champion adoption of platform-level social and discovery features, including friends, parties, and text chat into a native layer of the Epic ecosystem
Define and grow pathways for developers to participate in the broader epic ecosystem and metaverse economy, shaping new commercial models and open standards
Lead and grow a team of product managers, providing mentorship, organizational clarity, and the structure needed to execute a complex, multi-workstream roadmap effectively
Collaborate across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, and cross-functional partners to align on priorities, requirements, and go-to-market execution for major platform releases
What we're looking for
12+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent on developer tools, game engines, or complex platform ecosystems
Deep understanding of the game development process and the needs of creators and developers building on real-time 3D platforms
Proven ability to function as a business partner to engineering leadership someone who can bring goal-setting, prioritization frameworks, and growth thinking to a team that builds the platform others build on
Experience defining and tracking product KPIs, measuring roadmap impact, and using data to drive decisions
Strong understanding of platform ecosystem dynamics such as social features, marketplace integrations, developer services, and how they compound into long-term growth
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to align diverse stakeholders, write clear product requirements, and present strategy to senior leadership
Experience managing and developing high-performing product managers across multiple concurrent workstreams
A genuine passion for the creator and developer community; someone who stays close to how developers and players are evolving and can translate that into a compelling product vision
EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE
